## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Operators receive delegated stake from vaults but do not control it, and each vault decides how much stake each operator receives. Vault rewards accrue to the vault, so the VRT price rises as rewards build rather than rewards being paid out separately. (medium confidence) — https://www.jito.network/docs/restaking/ · keywords: Restaking on Solana with Jito restaking and Solayer · also: https://github.com/jito-foundation/restaking
- [statement] Operators receive delegated stake but have no direct control of it, and each vault decides how much stake each operator gets. Rewards accrue to the vault, so the VRT price rises instead of rewards being paid out separately. The NCN's registry entry stores no detailed config: accepted tokens, quorum and slashing conditions live in the NCN's own program. In the TipRouter and the default Template NCN, voting weight is frozen in a snapshot at the start of each consensus cycle, so stake moved mid-cycle cannot change voting power; the docs say other NCNs may define different snapshot mechanisms. (medium confidence) — https://www.jito.network/docs/restaking/ · keywords: Restaking on Solana with Jito restaking and Solayer · also: https://solanacompass.com/learn/accelerate-25/scale-or-die-accelerate-2025-node-consensus-networks-with-jito-restaking

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Connections are opt-in on every side. Operators and vaults register, then opt into an NCN; the NCN approves them and a warm-up instruction activates the link, so no party is connected automatically. A vault receipt token (VRT) can only be whitelisted for an NCN by three-way agreement among NCN developers, VRT providers and node operators, and third parties manage each NCN's allowlist. (medium confidence) — https://www.jito.network/docs/restaking/ · keywords: Restaking on Solana with Jito restaking and Solayer · also: https://forum.jito.network/t/jip-6-phased-deployment-of-jito-re-staking-protocol/385
- [statement] Jito (Re)staking is two onchain programs: the Restaking Program (RestkWeAVL8fRGgzhfeoqFhsqKRchg6aa1XrcH96z4Q), a registry of NCNs (node consensus networks) and operators, and the Vault Program (Vau1t6sLNxnzB7ZDsef8TLbPLfyZMYXH8WTNqUdm9g8), which holds deposited SPL tokens, delegates them to approved operators and mints vault receipt tokens (VRTs). Only coordination (delegation, votes, rewards, penalties) is tracked onchain; the NCN's real work runs offchain. The repo describes it as a framework for staking, restaking and liquid restaking on Solana and SVM environments. (high confidence) — https://www.jito.network/docs/restaking/ · keywords: Restaking on Solana with Jito restaking and Solayer · also: https://github.com/jito-foundation/restaking
